chapters.reason: The paper explicitly focuses on diffusion language models, specifically implementing DCoLT on masked diffusion models like LLaDA and continuous-time discrete diffusion models like SEDD.
The core contribution is a reinforcement learning framework (DCoLT) that optimizes the reasoning trajectory of diffusion models, acting as a specialized training strategy for iterative reasoning.
The paper demonstrates the application of its reasoning framework to complex tasks like math and code generation, showing significant accuracy improvements.
